The second World Health Assembly resolution on viral hepatitis in 2014 (WHA67.6): summary of Member State commitments and requests to WHO (2) f National strategies. Develop and implement coordinated multisectoral strategies for prevention, diagnosis and treatment, based on local epidemiology. f Health promotion and immunization. Strengthen health promotion and prevention, and enhance immunization strategies, including for hepatitis A, and for hepatitis B through a timely birth dose.
